introduction: Follow the Hunters’ warning through the city and Sunweaver, assemble the keystone, return foreign treasure or a lost monkey, help the naval officer, and bring Balance his distinct trophies and tokens. Exact supplied items can skip earlier personal recovery.
orientation: Discover Myrabolus and meet its residents to reveal their requests. These journals require active, ready accounting. Thirteen story outcomes are separate from three supporting services; asking questions and carrying materials do not finish an offering.

Enter the city northward from the Surface valley or eastward from its beach. The lagoon opens north to the ocean, and the dark forest connects south through secret bushes to Darkfall. Prepare for darkness, water and dangerous falls.

The parchment is in the locked gold chest in Roland’s empty house. At the crash site, SEARCH for the downward plank passage, OPEN it and descend; the old crate to the south holds a hidden gold key. OPEN and SEARCH the crate, then unlock and open the chest. The gold key normally breaks when used.

A palace guard carries the palace key. Beyond the gates, SEARCH for the hidden eastern passage to the Sunweaver, then open the bridge hatch to find Markam. He returns a parchment and gives one keystone half before leaving; Xavier separately exchanges a parchment for the observatory key.

The holy knight beyond the Home of the Holy’s closed curtain carries the other half. It is hidden and invisible: see invisible items before searching his body. Andryn needs both different halves. The knight’s half and assembled key can dissolve when dropped; the assembled key normally breaks when unlocking the secret treasury trapdoor.

Xavier’s observatory key opens the southern portal passage to the Hunt. The Hunt portal returns directly to that passage. Exact supplied materials can skip earlier personal collection or story stages; an earlier completed stage does not replace a material you have spent or given away.

Rico, Random, Decker and Alexis each offer a different reward for one chest of treasure from the Hunt. It is one quest item, with no container to open. Each delivery consumes its own copy. Decker leaves after his exchange; WAKE Alexis before asking about or giving her an offering.

The monkey hunter wants the hidden lost-monkey item from the Hunt, rather than the local living monkey. The naval officer wants a small wooden raft and hidden tree sap. The fixed floating life raft is a different object; Shantil’s raft shopping is currently unavailable.

Ask Balance hi, hello, howdy or hey about the three Rogue Plains tokens. All three different tokens make one offering. His drider staff and holy broadsword request is separate. His returned-letter referral is optional preparation for Seraphim in Desolate.

Paid armor crafting, shopping, smithing, epic lessons, paid storage and ticket purchases are currently unavailable with accounting active. The upstairs inn has separate rent conditions. The WaveDancer stops at the pier, but boarding still needs a valid ferry ticket.

contacts.name: Roland
contacts.description: Roland can wander beyond his usual city houses. His local head offering has no declared reward; the Hunt’s Roland offers a different exchange. His empty house contains the parchment chest.

contacts.name: Xavier
contacts.description: Xavier starts at the observatory. His three separate offerings take a parchment, Krazzi’s head or the delivery copy of the planetary study. The observatory key opens his locked southern portal passage.

contacts.name: Rico
contacts.description: Rico starts at his shop. He trades one Hunt treasure item for a combat vest; this offering is separate from his currently unavailable shopping service.

contacts.name: Random
contacts.description: Random starts in his home. One Hunt treasure item earns his ribbon of pride.

contacts.name: Andryn
contacts.description: Andryn starts at the smithy. He assembles two different keystone halves. His paid dragon-scale armor and FORGE services are currently unavailable.

contacts.name: Decker
contacts.description: Decker starts in his martial-arts dojo. He accepts one Hunt treasure item for a war helm, then leaves.

contacts.name: Alexis
contacts.description: Alexis starts asleep in her bedroom, beyond the living room’s closed door. WAKE her before asking about or giving an offering. Her treasure reward is a hazy amulet.

contacts.name: Markam, the High Magistrate
contacts.description: Markam starts in his Sunweaver quarters, beneath the bridge’s closed hatch. He returns a parchment and adds a keystone half, then leaves. A supplied parchment can satisfy his request.

contacts.name: a monkey hunter
contacts.description: The monkey hunter starts in the northern garden and can wander. He wants the exact lost-monkey item from the Hunt; the living local monkey cannot satisfy this offering.

contacts.name: an orc naval officer
contacts.description: The naval officer starts at the western beach. Bring a small wooden raft and hidden tree sap for two Squall items and coins. The fixed life raft is a different object.

contacts.name: Balance
contacts.description: Balance starts at the pier. Ask hi, hello, howdy or hey about the Rogue Plains tokens. His staff-and-sword offering and optional returned-letter referral are separate requests.

contacts.name: Michal Valentyne
contacts.description: The holy knight starts beyond the Home of the Holy’s closed curtain. His equipped whitestone broadsword and hidden, invisible keystone half serve different requests. See invisible items before searching for the half.

contacts.name: a celestial white dragon
contacts.description: The celestial white dragon starts at the fountain carrying a hidden huge scale. Search its body before retrieving the scale. Andryn’s paid scale offering is currently unavailable.

contacts.name: Mardoc
contacts.description: Mardoc starts in his study, above the sitting room behind a closed granite door. His equipped staff is one of Balance’s two local trophies.

contacts.name: a huge su-monster
contacts.description: The huge su-monster starts in the den. Hidden tree sap there serves the naval officer; its pelt has a separate experience exchange in Ultarium.

contacts.name: Ethan
contacts.description: Ethan carries a masters quiver, longbow and arrows and can wander outside his city house. Acquiring his equipment is separate from these offering stories.

contacts.name: Ajax
contacts.description: Ajax starts in his arena, behind a closed door. His training is separate from the local offering stories.

contacts.name: Dutch
contacts.description: Dutch starts at the bank and directs currency exchange to the Royal Bank. The bank counter’s paid locker service is currently unavailable.

contacts.name: a duergar bartender
contacts.description: The bartender starts at the inn tavern and offers changing world quests. These are separate from the journal’s local stories. The upstairs inn room offers rent subject to its own conditions.

contacts.name: a shapely waitress
contacts.description: The waitress tends the travelling tavern, behind a closed door. Crew hiring is a separate ship service and does not finish these offering stories.

contacts.name: the dock master
contacts.description: The dock master starts at the shipyard. Ship services and the ocean route are separate from local offerings.
